name: BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility
description: Research study comparing 30-day rolling realized volatility for BTC and ETH. Computes daily log returns, then rolling 30-day standard deviation annualized by sqrt(365) for crypto's 365-day trading calendar, expressed as a percentage. Outputs: (1) cross-sectional time series of realized vol, (2) summary statistics table, (3) BTC price chart, and (4) ETH/BTC vol ratio chart with a parity reference line at 1.0. The vol ratio charts use reference data sources to load both assets simultaneously.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility
# =============================================================================
# Daily log returns → rolling 30-day stddev → annualize × sqrt(365) → percentage
# Crypto trades 365 days/year, so annualization uses sqrt(365)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Daily log returns ---
log_ret = ln(close / (close >> 1))

# --- Rolling 30-day realized volatility (annualized, as %) ---
# stddev(30) gives rolling 30-day standard deviation of log returns
# Multiply by sqrt(365) to annualize, then × 100 for percentage
rv_30d = stddev(period=30)(log_ret) * sqrt(365) * 100

# --- Timestamp for X-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Rolling realized vol comparison over time
cs_lines(
    title='BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility',
    category='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Realized Volatility (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rv_30d)

# Pre-aggregate each metric so that agg=Last on the table picks up the correct value
rv_current = rv_30d                                  # Last value taken by table agg
rv_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(rv_30d)  # Expanding mean → Last = overall mean
rv_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(rv_30d)   # Expanding max → Last = all-time max
rv_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(rv_30d)   # Expanding min → Last = all-time min

# Table: Summary statistics per asset
cs_summary_table(
    title='Realized Volatility Summary',
    category='Volatility',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Realized Volatility Summary',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ],
        include_timestamp=False
    ),
    order=1
)(rv_current, rv_avg, rv_max, rv_min)

# =============================================================================
# NEW: BTC Price & ETH/BTC Vol Ratio Charts
# =============================================================================
# Load BTC and ETH data via reference to compute ratio in a single context.
# Platform does not support dual y-axes, so we use two paired charts
# grouped under the same dashboard category for visual proximity.
# =============================================================================

# --- Reference data for BTC and ETH ---
btc_ref = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
eth_ref = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.ETHUSD)()

btc_close = btc_ref.c
eth_close = eth_ref.c

# --- Compute 30-day realized vol for each (same methodology as above) ---
btc_log_ret = ln(btc_close / (btc_close >> 1))
eth_log_ret = ln(eth_close / (eth_close >> 1))

btc_rv = stddev(period=30)(btc_log_ret) * sqrt(365) * 100
eth_rv = stddev(period=30)(eth_log_ret) * sqrt(365) * 100

# --- ETH/BTC vol ratio (>1 = ETH more volatile, <1 = BTC more volatile) ---
vol_ratio = eth_rv / btc_rv

# Chart 2: BTC Price
xy_lines(
    title='BTC Price',
    category='BTC Price vs ETH/BTC Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_label='BTC Price ($)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=btc_close)

# Chart 3: ETH/BTC Vol Ratio with reference line at 1.0
xy_lines(
    title='ETH/BTC Vol Ratio',
    category='BTC Price vs ETH/BTC Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_label='Vol Ratio (ETH / BTC)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ETH/BTC Vol Ratio', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Parity', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=vol_ratio)
